scenarios.name: Close the Sketch Constrain expansion when switching tabs

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open and active outside sketch edit
the full Sketch ribbon is selected
the Constrain additional-command area is closed
the user opens the Constrain additional-command area
the additional area appears below the Sketch ribbon
its visible commands are unavailable outside sketch edit
the user selects the 3D Model ribbon tab
the user returns to the Sketch ribbon tab
the Sketch ribbon is visible with its Constrain additional area closed
